newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain sees private consumption still picking up.
newsitem.headline: Spain sees private consumption still picking up.

text.p: Spanish private consumption should continue a pick-up initiated last year, the Economy Ministry's March report said on Monday.

"Indicators available for 1997...point to an acceleration of this (private consumption) recovery trend observed last year," the report said, adding that information available referring to this year was limited.
The ministry backed its forecast with estimated increases in car sales and an improvement in consumer confidence.
"The recovery of confidence and in families' financial position, which is fundamentally healthy, should promote greater private consumption growth in the next few months," it said.
This should be reflected in higher rates of employment creation as well as fewer temporary job contracts particularly after a labour reform deal struck between unions and employers last week.
The Bank of Spain's March report, published recently, also said household consumption had accelerated at the beginning of the year.
